text:
marta: Vendor delivered a refreshed price file for 'AI Edge' (price_id=AE-2026-11). Need finance + billing ops + legal to review before any shadow/canary. Sheet: https://vendor.example.com/sheets/AE-2026-11
liam: Quick check: commits/reserved SKUs touched or PAYG only?
sophia: We must ensure legacy coupons and grandfathering flags remain mapped; sales will push back otherwise.
marta: PAYG only. Changes: new metered token tier breakpoints, invoice line rename, and a minor rounding rule change.
devin: Pulled the mapping CSV. Noted three edge cases: percent-off coupons, manually-invoiced accounts, and accounts with custom billing_cycle_day. Sample: ```acct_id,grandfathered,apply_new_rate
501001,true,false
501002,false,true```
marta: @billing-bot enqueue preview for cohort "ai-edge-price-exp" (~11k accounts). Request: invoice delta histogram, coupon collision %, and top-15 anomalies.
billing-bot: billing-bot: Preview job queued job_id=jb_8201. ETA ~11m.
cara: Legal flagged a non-standard termination line; asked vendor to remove. Not blocking preview but needs resolution before final contract.
billing-bot: job complete job_id=jb_8201. Summary: cohort_B median invoice +1.6%, coupon collisions 0.10%. Anomalies: 27 accounts with negative delta > $1k (proration/rounding edge). Report: https://internal/reports/jb_8201
sophia: I'll generate stratified A/B cohorts by revenue decile and export grandfathered-account list. ETA ~2h.
devin: Can prepare a small translation-table patch to normalise rounding and handle proration. Request permission to run in canary first.
marta: Approved to patch in canary and validate. Abort criteria: coupon collisions >0.5% OR >75 accounts with >$1k negative delta. Finance must sign off if negative exposure > $40k.
liam: Will run exposure calc once preview numbers are in; standing by.
sam: Sales wants comms copy that clarifies grandfathering and rounding differences. I'll draft and share after cohorts are final.
marta: Target: 1% PAYG canary tomorrow 09:00 PT if canary hotfix validates. I'll post runbook in #release-war-room and loop in customer success for outbound comms. Keep updates here.
